name: web-modernize
description: Guides teams through migrating legacy web applications (ASP.NET WebForms, Java/JSP, AngularJS 1.x, etc.) to modern stacks. Provides slash commands for analyze, plan, scaffold (legacy-asset copy + toolchain preflight), unit-by-unit migration, behavioural-parity and security review, advisory migration-quality (idiomatic-code) review, rollback, retry, sync, and progress reporting. State is split across per-unit files for multi-developer concurrency.
